— Stops, belts, air bags, child seats","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Stops, belts, air bags, child seats

FACT_ID: sec12-F01 | anchor: A01
Buckling up doubles crash-survival odds and more than doubles the odds of dodging grave injury [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec12-F02 | anchor: A01
Virginia belts every seat: driver plus all front and rear riders must buckle, and whoever drives anyone under 18 must lock that young rider into a belt, booster, or child seat wherever seated [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec12-F03 | anchor: A01
Ride the lap strap low across lap and thighs with the shoulder strap over shoulder and chest, snug, never slung behind the back or beneath the arm; expectant mothers belt lowest on the pelvis [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec12-F04 | anchor: A01
A licensed physician can waive belting where a physical or medical condition makes it unreasonable; the waived person must pocket the signed statement naming bearer and reason [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec12-F05 | anchor: A01
When flagged down, stay calm, park at a safe roadside, remain seated unless summoned out, flash the hazards, glow the dome light by night, kill engine, radio, and chatter-blocking gadgets, and drop the window since the officer may land on either side [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec12-F06 | anchor: A01
Through the stop, belts stay buckled for driver and riders, every hand stays visible atop the wheel, and no move may hint at hiding or grabbing [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec12-F07 | anchor: A01
Keep license, registration, and insurance aboard; when asked, call out their spot, fetch them slowly with one hand still wheeled, and feel free to demand ID from unmarked or uniformless officers [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec12-F08 | anchor: A01
Answer fully and plainly, bank disputes for the courtroom, and sign the handed citation, which concedes no guilt, since refusal risks arrest or a station ride [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec12-F09 | anchor: FXsec12F09
A licensed physician may waive child restraints for weight, physical fitness or other medical grounds. The transporter must carry the signed statement identifying the child and the reason. Drivers must secure children properly; a first conviction costs fifty dollars, and a later offense can carry a five-hundred-dollar penalty [FXsec12F09].
Source: [FXsec12F09 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec12-F10 | anchor: A02
Seat children center-back for peak safety, verify installs at locality check events, never cradle a child aboard since crashes sandwich them against dash or seatback, and run doors shut, locked, and child-locked with handles off-limits, halting fully before any door opens [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec12-F11 | anchor: A02
Children may never ride wagon luggage bays nor under open hatchbacks, and under-sixteens may never ride pickup beds even beneath camper shells [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec12-F12 | anchor: A02
Paired with belts, bags pillow riders through frontal hits, sparing head, neck, and chest from column and dash while softening the blow [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec12-F13 | anchor: A02
With bags aboard, buckle all, slide at least ten inches off the wheel, dip adjustable wheels so bags aim at chests, and buckle twelve-and-unders behind [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec12-F14 | anchor: A02
Under-eights ride harnessed in seats or boosters in post-January 1, 1968 cars, rear-facing from birth to 2 years or the maker's bound, forward-facing after, keeping seats or boosters until at least age 8 or genuine belt fit, with front seats allowed only minus back seats and minus live passenger bags [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec12-F15 | anchor: A02
Booster graduation needs all seven: snug lap on upper thighs, snug shoulder on shoulder and chest, tall unsloouched sit, knees bending at the cushion edge, spine flush to the seatback, soles planted, held the whole ride [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]
